SELECT d.ALGORITHM_ID ,d.TITLE ,d.DESCRIPTION ,d.DOCKER_CMD ,d.TRAIN_PARAM ,d.INFERENCE_PARAM ,d.CREATED_DATE ,d.USER_ID ,d.IS_ENABLE ,d.IS_FIXED ,d.BASE_IMAGE ,d.TRAIN_FUNC_NAME ,d.LOAD_FUNC_NAME ,d.INFERENCE_FUNC_NAME ,d.LABEL_TYPE FROM ALGORITHM d WHERE 1=1 AND USER_ID = #{user_id} AND TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%',#{title},'%') AND DESCRIPTION LIKE CONCAT('%',#{description},'%') AND LABEL_TYPE = #{label_type} OR TITLE = "YOLO" AND IS_ENABLE = 1
ORDER BY d.ALGORITHM_ID ASC

SELECT d.ALGORITHM_ID ,d.TITLE ,d.DESCRIPTION ,d.DOCKER_CMD ,d.TRAIN_PARAM ,d.INFERENCE_PARAM ,d.CREATED_DATE ,d.USER_ID ,d.IS_ENABLE ,d.IS_FIXED ,d.BASE_IMAGE ,d.TRAIN_FUNC_NAME ,d.LOAD_FUNC_NAME ,d.INFERENCE_FUNC_NAME ,d.LABEL_TYPE FROM ALGORITHM d WHERE 1=1 AND d.ALGORITHM_ID = #{algorithm_id}

SELECT d.ALGORITHM_ID ,d.TITLE ,d.DESCRIPTION ,d.DOCKER_CMD ,d.TRAIN_PARAM ,d.INFERENCE_PARAM ,d.CREATED_DATE ,d.USER_ID ,d.IS_ENABLE ,d.IS_FIXED ,d.BASE_IMAGE ,d.TRAIN_FUNC_NAME ,d.LOAD_FUNC_NAME ,d.INFERENCE_FUNC_NAME ,d.LABEL_TYPE FROM ALGORITHM d WHERE 1=1 AND d.ALGORITHM_ID IN (${algorithm_id})

SELECT COUNT(d.ALGORITHM_ID) AS TOTAL_COUNT FROM ALGORITHM d WHERE 1=1 AND USER_ID = #{user_id} AND TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%',#{title},'%') AND DESCRIPTION LIKE CONCAT('%',#{description},'%') AND LABEL_TYPE = #{label_type} AND IS_ENABLE = 1 ORDER BY d.ALGORITHM_ID ASC
SELECT d.TASK_ID ,d.ALGORITHM_ID FROM TASK d WHERE 1=1 AND d.ALGORITHM_ID = #{algorithm_id}
